fields.FIR_Description: A written complaint dated 2026-01-07 states that an unidentified customer allegedly took cosmetic products worth Rs. 3,50,000 from Mullai Footwear near Anbu Park Main Street, on 2026-01-07 at roughly 20:15. Arun Prakash approached Trichy Central PS to report the matter and can be reached on 9000000194. The complainant is associated with the business Mullai Footwear. Siva Sekar (9000000284) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. Elango Shankar (mobile 9000000317) was named as a possible person of interest. The complainant mentioned a witness statement and CCTV footage.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspect allegedly posed as a customer and took items while staff were attending to others.
fields.Keywords: shop theft, stock, CCTV, witness statement, evening, suspect, witness, mobile number
